<h1 id="grok-stt">Grok STT</h1>

<p><code>xai/grok-stt</code></p>

xAI's Grok speech-to-text model. Transcribes audio files into text across 25 languages with word-level timestamps, multichannel transcription, speaker diarization, and key-term biasing.

<div class="table-scroll"><table><tbody>
<tr><th>Task</th><td>Automatic Speech Recognition</td></tr>
<tr><th>Terms</th><td><a href="https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service">Model terms</a></td></tr>
<tr><th>Unit pricing</th><td>Per audio minute: 0.001667, input_audio_minutes_streaming: 0.003334</td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>

<h2 id="usage">Usage</h2>

Pass an HTTPS URL and let xAI fetch the audio server-side — simplest path

<section class="model-example"><strong>Transcribe from URL</strong>
<p>Pass an HTTPS URL and let xAI fetch the audio server-side — simplest path</p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{
  &quot;input&quot;: {
    &quot;url&quot;: &quot;https://storage.googleapis.com/cloud-samples-data/speech/brooklyn_bridge.mp3&quot;
  },
  &quot;output&quot;: {
    &quot;text&quot;: &quot;How old is the Brooklyn Bridge?&quot;
  },
  &quot;raw_response&quot;: {
    &quot;state&quot;: &quot;Completed&quot;,
    &quot;result&quot;: {
      &quot;text&quot;: &quot;How old is the Brooklyn Bridge?&quot;,
      &quot;language&quot;: &quot;English&quot;,
      &quot;duration&quot;: 1.85,
      &quot;words&quot;: [
        {
          &quot;text&quot;: &quot;How&quot;,
          &quot;start&quot;: 0.14,
          &quot;end&quot;: 0.28
        },
        {
          &quot;text&quot;: &quot;old&quot;,
          &quot;start&quot;: 0.4,
          &quot;end&quot;: 0.6
        },
        {
          &quot;text&quot;: &quot;is&quot;,
          &quot;start&quot;: 0.65,
          &quot;end&quot;: 0.75
        },
        {
          &quot;text&quot;: &quot;the&quot;,
          &quot;start&quot;: 0.81,
          &quot;end&quot;: 0.89
        },
        {
          &quot;text&quot;: &quot;Brooklyn&quot;,
          &quot;start&quot;: 0.95,
          &quot;end&quot;: 1.29
        },
        {
          &quot;text&quot;: &quot;Bridge?&quot;,
          &quot;start&quot;: 1.35,
          &quot;end&quot;: 1.69
        }
      ]
    },
    &quot;gatewayMetadata&quot;: {
      &quot;keySource&quot;: &quot;Unified&quot;
    }
  }
}</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">const response = await env.AI.run(
  &#x27;xai/grok-stt&#x27;,
  { url: &#x27;https://storage.googleapis.com/cloud-samples-data/speech/brooklyn_bridge.mp3&#x27; },
)
console.log(response)</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-bash">curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID/ai/run \
  --header &quot;Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN&quot; \
  --header &quot;Content-Type: application/json&quot; \
  --data &#x27;{
  &quot;model&quot;: &quot;xai/grok-stt&quot;,
  &quot;input&quot;: {
    &quot;url&quot;: &quot;https://storage.googleapis.com/cloud-samples-data/speech/brooklyn_bridge.mp3&quot;
  }
}&#x27;</code></pre>
</section>

<h2 id="parameters">Parameters</h2>

<h3 id="input">Input</h3>

<div class="table-scroll"><table><thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Type</th><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>file</code></td><td>string</td><td>Audio file as a data URI (data:audio/...;base64,...) or an HTTPS URL the gateway fetches and uploads. Supported container formats: flac, mp3, mp4, m4a, mkv, ogg, opus, wav, aac. Raw formats (pcm, mulaw, alaw) also accepted — supply audio_format and sample_rate. Gateway-side size limit: 25 MB. Mutually exclusive with `url`.</td></tr><tr><td><code>url</code></td><td>string</td><td>HTTPS URL of an audio file for xAI to fetch server-side. Mutually exclusive with `file` and `websocket`. No gateway-side size limit applies.</td></tr><tr><td><code>websocket</code></td><td>boolean</td><td>Enable WebSocket streaming for speech-to-text. When true, establishes a bidirectional WebSocket connection for real-time audio transcription. Mutually exclusive with `file` and `url`.</td></tr><tr><td><code>audio_format</code></td><td>string</td><td>Format hint for raw/headerless audio. Required for pcm, mulaw, alaw. Omit for container formats (mp3, wav, etc.) — xAI auto-detects them. Values: pcm, mulaw, alaw</td></tr><tr><td><code>sample_rate</code></td><td>integer</td><td>Sample rate in Hz. Required when audio_format is set. Minimum: -9007199254740991; Maximum: 9007199254740991</td></tr><tr><td><code>language</code></td><td>string</td><td>Language code (e.g. "en", "fr", "de"). Used with format=true to enable Inverse Text Normalization. xAI transcribes in any language regardless — supplying this enables number/currency formatting in the transcript.</td></tr><tr><td><code>format</code></td><td>boolean</td><td>When true, enables Inverse Text Normalization — spoken numbers and currencies are converted to written form (e.g. "one hundred dollars" → "$100"). Requires language to be set.</td></tr><tr><td><code>diarize</code></td><td>boolean</td><td>When true, enables speaker diarization. Each word in the response includes a `speaker` integer identifying the detected speaker.</td></tr><tr><td><code>filler_words</code></td><td>boolean</td><td>When true, filler words (uh, um, er) are included in the transcript. Defaults to false — filler words are removed.</td></tr><tr><td><code>multichannel</code></td><td>boolean</td><td>When true, each audio channel is transcribed independently. Results are returned in the `channels` array. Requires channels ≥ 2.</td></tr><tr><td><code>channels</code></td><td>integer</td><td>Number of audio channels (2–8). Required only for multichannel raw audio; auto-detected for container formats. Minimum: 2; Maximum: 8</td></tr><tr><td><code>keyterm</code></td><td>array</td><td>Key terms to bias transcription toward (e.g. product names, proper nouns). Each term up to 50 characters, max 100 terms. Sent as repeated form fields: keyterm=Term+One&amp;keyterm=Term+Two.</td></tr></tbody></table></div>

<h3 id="output">Output</h3>

<div class="table-scroll"><table><thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Type</th><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>text</code></td><td>string</td><td>Required. Full transcript text.</td></tr><tr><td><code>language</code></td><td>string</td><td>Detected language name (e.g. "English", "French").</td></tr><tr><td><code>duration</code></td><td>number</td><td>Audio duration in seconds (2 d.p.).</td></tr><tr><td><code>words</code></td><td>array</td><td>Word-level segments. Each entry has text, start, end (seconds). Includes speaker integer when diarize=true.</td></tr><tr><td><code>words[].text</code></td><td>string</td><td>Required.</td></tr><tr><td><code>words[].start</code></td><td>number</td><td>Required.</td></tr><tr><td><code>words[].end</code></td><td>number</td><td>Required.</td></tr><tr><td><code>words[].speaker</code></td><td>number</td><td></td></tr><tr><td><code>channels</code></td><td>array</td><td>Per-channel transcripts when multichannel=true.</td></tr><tr><td><code>channels[].index</code></td><td>number</td><td>Required.</td></tr><tr><td><code>channels[].text</code></td><td>string</td><td>Required.</td></tr><tr><td><code>channels[].words</code></td><td>array</td><td></td></tr><tr><td><code>channels[].words[].text</code></td><td>string</td><td>Required.</td></tr><tr><td><code>channels[].words[].start</code></td><td>number</td><td>Required.</td></tr><tr><td><code>channels[].words[].end</code></td><td>number</td><td>Required.</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
